full_judgment: "66. Presumption and determination of age (1) Whenever a person, whether charged with an offence or not, is brought before any criminal Court otherwise than for the purpose of giving evidence, and it appears to the Court that he is a child, the Court shall make an inquiry as to the age of that person and for that purpose, shall take such evidence as may be forthcoming at the hearing of the cases, and shall record a finding thereon, stating his age as nearly as may be.
